# Sunmeld

> Sunmeld (Space Merge Duel) is a player-versus-AI merge duel for iOS and Android, now in development. Take turns dropping space stones into one shared tub, merge them into bigger worlds, and do not be the one who overflows it.

Sunmeld is a casual player-versus-AI mobile game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is coming soon to iOS and Android and has NOT been released: no store page or release date exists yet. This site is the game's home and its journal.

## Key facts

- You and an AI opponent take turns dropping space stones into one shared tub.
- Two stones of the same stage that touch merge into the next stage, from dust up to a sun.
- The player who causes a merge scores it; if the tub overflows, the player who placed the last stone loses.
- Each AI opponent has its own habits.
- Free to try; a single purchase unlocks everything. No ads.

## Privacy

- The Sunmeld app collects no personal information and contains no ads, analytics or tracking SDKs.
- This website collects only basic visit statistics through Google Analytics and has no ads; see the privacy policy.

## Languages

The site is available in 12 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 繁體中文, Español, Português (Brasil), Français, Deutsch, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe. Each language lives under /<code>/ (English at the root).
